title: Hunting in Sentinel: Queries, KQL Jobs, Summary Rules, Notebooks and the MCP Server

header.html: Create and monitor hunting queries; create and manage KQL jobs in Data lake; create and manage Summary rule tables for querying; hunt for threats by using Notebooks, including connection to the Sentinel MCP Server
the official Microsoft SC-200 study guide (skills measured as of October 21, 2026) and Microsoft Learn

toc.title: KQL jobs in the data lake

html:
1The Sentinel Hunting page

Path in the Defender portal: Microsoft Sentinel > Threat management > Hunting. Tabs: Queries, Bookmarks, Hunts (preview).

Feature Fact
Queries tab Content hub and custom queries, grouped by MITRE ATT&CK tactic and technique
Run Run all queries, Run selected queries, or a single query
Results delta Compares the last 24 hours with the previous 24 to 48 hours
Favorites Run automatically each time the Hunting page opens
N/A The query lacks required data sources (hover to see them)
Create an alert From query results: New alert rule > Create Microsoft Sentinel alert
Livestream No longer available; use KQL jobs, analytics rules or playbooks
Bookmarks Fact
Create Only in the Azure portal; in the Defender portal you can view existing bookmarks
Fields Name, tags, notes, MITRE tactics and techniques, entity mapping
Entity mapping At least one is needed to open the investigation graph
Storage HuntingBookmark table
Use Add to an incident or create a new one; bookmarks are not in Advanced hunting

Hunts (preview) organize a hypothesis, its queries, bookmarks, entities and comments. They need Microsoft Sentinel Contributor (or a role with Microsoft.SecurityInsights/hunts). Hypotheses can come from the MITRE map, recent hunting query results, Content hub solutions or your own idea.

Exam tip

. Bookmarks are created in the Azure portal only. Livestream is gone. Favorites run when the page opens.

2KQL jobs in the data lake

A KQL job runs a query against the data lake once or on a schedule and writes the results to a table. It is how you promote lake data to the Analytics tier so that analytics rules can use it.

Fact Detail
Path Microsoft Sentinel > Data lake exploration > Jobs > Create job (or from the KQL query editor)
Output table New tables get the suffix _KQL_CL in the Analytics tier; one output table per job
Schedule By minute, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly; start at least 30 minutes after creation; end date or run indefinitely
Latency New data can take up to 15 minutes to be queryable; use a delay
Roles Security operator, Security administrator or Global administrator
Name Unique per tenant, up to 256 characters, no # or -
Limit (per tenant) Value
Concurrent jobs 5 (extra runs are rejected, not queued)
Job timeout 1 hour
Enabled jobs 100
Time range Up to 12 years
Not supported adx(), arg(), externaldata(), ingestion_time(), user-defined functions

KQL queries in the lake (Data lake exploration > KQL queries) allow interactive queries with limits: 500,000 rows or 64 MB for a synchronous run, 30 queries per minute per tenant, 10 concurrent; async queries time out after 1 hour and cache results for 24 hours; history is kept 30 days.

Exam tip

. Big, old, cheap data → query it in the lake. Need alerts on it → KQL job to the Analytics tier.

3Summary rules

Summary rules aggregate large, verbose data on a schedule into a small custom table, so queries and detections on the summary are fast and cheap. They live in the Log Analytics workspace (Settings > Rules > Summary rules > Create).

Setting Fact
binSize 20, 30, 60, 120, 180, 360, 720 or 1440 minutes
Destination table Name must end in _CL
Query Do not add a time filter; the bin size controls the time range
Source Analytics tables (most operators), or one Basic table (with lookup to up to 5 Analytics tables)
Target size Results should be at most 0.01% of the source; each record under 1 MB
Limits 100 active rules per workspace
Failures Each failed bin retries up to 10 times in 8 hours; 8 consecutive failures make the rule inactive
Monitoring Table LASummaryLogs (Started, Succeeded, Failed)
Roles Log Analytics Contributor to create or change; Log Analytics Reader to query
Exam tip

. Summary rule = reduce volume (aggregate). KQL job = move or enrich lake data. Both write to a table with _CL or _KQL_CL.

4Notebooks in the data lake

Notebooks run Python and Spark in Visual Studio Code with the Microsoft Sentinel extension, for deep hunting, machine learning and graph building. MSTICPy, the open-source Microsoft threat intelligence library, helps in investigations.

Fact Detail
Provider Class MicrosoftSentinelProvider from sentinel_lake.providers, created with spark; methods read_table and save_as_table
Pools Small (light work, lower cost), Medium (ETL, joins, aggregations, ML training), Large (deep learning, heavy shuffles, time-sensitive)
Session start About 3 to 5 minutes; default session timeout 30 minutes
Limits Interactive inactivity 20 minutes; notebook job 8 hours; 3 concurrent notebook jobs; VS Code shows 100,000 rows
Libraries Azure Synapse libraries 3.4 and the Sentinel provider only; no pip installs
Roles Security operator, Security administrator, Global administrator to write

5The Microsoft Sentinel MCP server

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server is a hosted service that lets AI tools and agents query Sentinel data with the user's own permissions. It uses Microsoft Entra for identity; there is no infrastructure to deploy.

Collection Purpose
Data exploration Search tables, query the lake, analyze entities
Triage Triage incidents and hunt over your data
Security Copilot agent creation Create Security Copilot agents
Fact Detail
Prerequisite Most tools need data lake onboarding
Role Security reader is needed to list and invoke tools
Clients Security Copilot, Copilot Studio, Foundry, Visual Studio Code
Custom tools Build an MCP tool from a saved KQL query in advanced hunting
Exam tip

. MCP is how an AI client reaches Sentinel data. It cannot see more than the signed-in user's permissions allow.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Verbose firewall logs are very large. The SOC wants an hourly summary in a small table for fast detection queries. What should be created?

  • AA KQL job that runs once and deletes the source table
  • BA notebook that runs every night in a large pool
  • CA bookmark that stores every firewall event
  • DA summary rule with a 60 minute bin and a _CL destination
Show the answer

Answer: D. A summary rule aggregates data on a schedule into a custom _CL table; bin sizes include 60 minutes.

S2Two years of network logs sit in the data lake. The SOC wants a nightly job that finds suspicious connections and writes them to the Analytics tier for alerting. What should be used?

  • AA Livestream session on the Hunting page
  • BA manual bookmark created in the Defender portal
  • CA scheduled KQL job with a daily schedule
  • DA custom detection rule on the lake table
Show the answer

Answer: C. A scheduled KQL job queries the lake and writes results (_KQL_CL) to the Analytics tier.

S3A tenant already runs five KQL jobs and a sixth starts. What happens?

  • AThe sixth job is queued and starts when one finishes
  • BThe sixth job is rejected because the limit is five
  • CThe sixth job replaces the oldest running job
  • DThe sixth job runs more slowly with less data
Show the answer

Answer: B. Five concurrent jobs are allowed per tenant, and extra runs are rejected, not queued.

S4An analyst wants to save interesting query rows for an incident. In which portal can bookmarks be created?

  • AOnly the Azure portal; the Defender portal views them
  • BBoth the Azure portal and the Defender portal
  • COnly the Defender portal, in Advanced hunting
  • DNeither portal, because bookmarks have been retired from Sentinel
Show the answer

Answer: A. Bookmarks are created in the Azure portal only; the Defender portal can show existing ones.

S5A data scientist trains a deep learning model in a Sentinel notebook. Which pool fits best?

  • ASmall, for light development work at lower cost
  • BLarge, for deep learning and heavy shuffles
  • CMedium, for ETL and joins on moderate volumes
  • DNone, because notebooks run only on local computers
Show the answer

Answer: B. Large pools are for deep learning, heavy shuffles and time-sensitive jobs.

S6A team wants an AI assistant to triage incidents using Sentinel data under the signed-in analyst's permissions. Which feature should be connected?

  • AThe Sentinel MCP server Triage collection
  • BA summary rule that writes to a _CL table
  • CA KQL job with a weekly schedule
  • DA workbook template from the Content hub
Show the answer

Answer: A. The MCP server Triage collection lets AI clients triage incidents with the user's permissions.

6.2 Recall questions

R1Which suffix do KQL job output tables get?

Show the answer

_KQL_CL.

R2How many concurrent KQL jobs per tenant?

Show the answer

Five.

R3Which bin sizes can summary rules use?

Show the answer

20, 30, 60, 120, 180, 360, 720 or 1440 minutes.

R4Where do Sentinel notebooks run?

Show the answer

Visual Studio Code with the Microsoft Sentinel extension.

R5Which feature replaced Livestream?

Show the answer

KQL jobs, analytics rules and playbooks.

R6Which MCP collection triages incidents?

Show the answer

Triage.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Hunting page queries by MITRE, results delta, favorites; bookmarks created in the Azure portal only
KQL jobs lake to Analytics tier; _KQL_CL; 5 concurrent, 1 hour timeout, 100 enabled
Lake queries 500,000 rows or 64 MB; 30 per minute; async 1 hour
Summary rules aggregate; binSize 20 to 1440; _CL; no time filter
Notebooks VS Code, Spark, Small/Medium/Large, no pip
MCP data exploration, triage, agent creation; Entra permissions
